# Background

The purpose of this workflow is to complete basic data cleaning of metadata and RNA-seq libraries. This includes 1) removing low coverage libraries, 2) filtering rare genes, 3) removing outlying libraries and duplicates, and 4) normalizing for RNA composition.

# Setup and Configuration


## Directory Structure Configuration

```{r}
projectNumber <- "P200-1"
dirBoxBase <-
  file.path("~", "Library", "CloudStorage", "Box-Box")
dirRoot <-
  file.path(
    dirBoxBase,
    "Bioinformatics_R_scripts", # Box version
    "Testing/Project_dirs_function/",
    # "~", "Documents", "Projects_local", # local version
    projectNumber
  )
proj <- init_project_dirs(projectNumber, box_base = dirBoxBase, lab_folder = "Bioinformatics_R_scripts/Testing/Project_dirs_function")

proj$root
proj$plots
proj$results

il13_plot <- init_experiment_dirs(proj$plots, "IL13",plot_subdirs = c("GSEA","Norm"),result_subdirs = c("GSEA","Norm"))
il13_plot$results_GSEA
```
